brand.name: Open House
brand.vibe: Sleek, laid-back, editorial-style, gallery-meets-record-shop, welcoming, open, calm, social, creative, effortlessly cool, minimal but warm.
brand.archetype: Organic & Earthy mixed with Swiss & High-Contrast (soft editorial restraint)
brand.mission: An independent online radio station and cultural platform focused on music, art, creative projects, community, and emerging talent.

typography.instructions_to_main_agent: Import these fonts via Google Fonts. Use them strictly as defined. Do not use generic fonts like Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk. Enable fluid typography scaling for oversized headings.

primary.usage: Headings, massive typography moments, bold statements

secondary.usage: Body copy, UI elements, labels, buttons

accent.usage: Emphasis, pull quotes, manifesto numbers, subtle editorial touches

scale.h1: text-6xl md:text-[8vw] leading-[0.9] tracking-tighter font-black uppercase
scale.quote: text-2xl md:text-4xl font-accent italic leading-tight text-primary/80
scale.label: text-xs md:text-sm uppercase tracking-[0.15em] font-secondary font-medium

colors.instructions_to_main_agent: Stick strictly to this palette. The design requires a soft, premium off-white background with charcoal text. Do not use pure white (#FFFFFF) or pure black (#000000). Use the accent color purposefully for hovers, subtle highlights, or callout cards.

visual_enhancers.instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize a physical, tactile feel without skeuomorphism. Subtle grain and precise borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the primary background (opacity 1.5%).
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #E6E4E0 for structural grids and cards. No drop shadows.
visual_enhancers.radii: rounded-none or minimal rounded-sm (2px) to maintain editorial rigidness.
visual_enhancers.images: Real photography treated deliberately. Use grayscale filtering on hover, or spotlight masking. Crop images cleanly.

layout.instructions_to_main_agent: Embrace whitespace. Use a structured grid with deliberate asymmetry. Use generous padding (p-8 to p-24).

motion.instructions_to_main_agent: Use framer-motion and lenis for a premium Awwwards-level feel. All motion must be purposeful, not distracting.
motion.hero_reveal: Masked line-by-line reveal for the H1 on page load (y: '100%' to '0%', staggerChildren: 0.1, duration: 1s, ease: [0.76, 0, 0.24, 1]).
motion.scroll: Smooth scrolling via Lenis. Subtle parallax on hero image and major section images (y: -10% to 10% based on scroll progress).
motion.hover: Image zoom (scale 1.05) within overflow-hidden containers. Text links: custom underline animation (scale-x 0 to 1 origin-left).
motion.marquee: Slow editorial marquee for the 'OPEN HOUSE' brand statement or current schedule.

components.instructions_to_main_agent: Build custom components with these specific structural rules. Avoid default Shadcn styles; heavily customize them to fit the editorial aesthetic.

navigation.style: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#F9F8F6]/80 border-b border-[#E6E4E0] transition-colors duration-300
navigation.layout: Flex space-between, wordmark left, links center (desktop), Listen Live CTA right.
navigation.note: Never use a fully transparent background for the nav.

buttons.primary: bg-text_primary text-background px-8 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-accent hover:text-text_primary transition-colors duration-300
buttons.secondary: border border-text_primary text-text_primary px-8 py-3 uppercase tracking-widest text-sm hover:bg-surface transition-colors duration-300

cards.style: bg-surface border border-border p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 group cursor-pointer transition-colors hover:bg-[#F9F8F6]
cards.typography: h3 for title, label for category/genre.

radio_player.style: bg-player_dark text-player_dark_text p-6 flex items-center justify-between border-t border-player_dark/10
radio_player.placeholder: Radio.co embed placeholder UI. Include Play/Pause button, 'Live Now' pulsing indicator (red/accent), Show Title, Host.

forms.style: Minimalist inputs. border-b border-text_primary bg-transparent py-4 focus:outline-none focus:border-accent placeholder:text-text_secondary font-secondary transition-colors

home: Hero: Large kinetic typography 'OPEN HOUSE' (framer-motion masked reveal), brand statement marquee, absolute positioned 'Listen Live' floating badge.
Live Now: Radio player module anchored or in a prominent distinct section.
Upcoming Schedule Preview: Clean list layout (Time | Show | Host) with hover line-throughs or highlights.
Featured Shows: 3-column bento/grid of editorial cards.
Featured Projects: Asymmetrical grid showcasing community art/culture.
About Teaser: Large serif quote and read more link.
Community CTA: Full width split section (Pitch a Show / Submit Project).
radio: Live Now: Prominent display of current playing track/show.
Schedule: Full weekly schedule in an accordion or structured table format.
Residents: Grid of featured resident DJs with circular or pill-shaped clipped portraits.
shows: Directory: Curated programme grid. Filter tabs (Music, Talk, Guest Mix).
Cards: Show artwork, host name, genre.
projects: Grid: Masonry layout of community creative work.
Categories: Horizontal scrolling or sticky filter list (Music, Art, Events, Film, Photography, Fashion).
about: Manifesto: Numbered chapters using the accent Serif font (e.g., '01. The Mission').
Story: Editorial text layout with generous margins and inset imagery.
submit: Forms: Two minimal forms side-by-side or tabbed ('Pitch a Show' vs 'Submit a Project').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text_primary and text_secondary meet APCA/WCAG AA contrast against background and surface.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (links, buttons, forms, player controls) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='listen-live-btn').
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.

media.instructions_to_main_agent: Use these specific images for the designated sections to maintain the candid, cultural, non-corporate vibe.

hero_background.description: Close up of mixing board, candid DJ studio vibe (hero abstract or featured show)

featured_show_1.description: Vinyl record spinning (perfect for show artwork)

featured_project_1.description: Woman in gallery (Project artwork - Art category)

universal_guidelines.1: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
universal_guidelines.2: Create depth through layered design elements. Use strict grids but intentionally break them with overlapping elements.
universal_guidelines.3: Do NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
universal_guidelines.4: Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
universal_guidelines.5: Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
universal_guidelines.6: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute.
universal_guidelines.7: Do not center align the app container. Align text left by default.
universal_guidelines.8: NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
